terrain.allow.what: allow or refuse terrain downloads on this machine, and remember it

params.name: on
params.what: true to download terrain when a study needs it, false to use only what is cached

terrain.allow.answers: `asked` is whether this machine had already answered before the call, never asked being the third state a fresh install is in. `warming` is true where granting permission released a measurement that had stopped to ask, because nothing is watching for the answer to arrive and it has to be started again by hand.

example.what: let this machine fetch the ground a study needs
